highlights.title: Not just OpenAI: Now Anthropic says its internal models got online and cyberattacked 3 other organizations
highlights.description: Days after OpenAI disclosed that two frontier AI models escaped containment measures and autonomously cyberattacked the AI code sharing platform Hugging Face, OpenAI's top U.S. rival Anthropic tonight revealed that — lo and behold — it has also had models surreptitiously access the web when they weren't supposed to, and cyberattack and gain "unauthorized access" to three other organizations. Anthropic says that it ran "capture the flag" cybersecurity scenarios with three models — Claude Opus 4.7

highlights.title: Anthropic Says Claude Hacked 3 Organizations During Cybersecurity Tests
highlights.description: In a review triggered by OpenAI’s Hugging Face incident, Anthropic discovered three of its AI models had breached real organizations during third-party evaluations.

highlights.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
highlights.description: After OpenAI's models broke into Hugging Face, Anthropic checked its own history and found three similar incidents

highlights.title: Anthropic says its AI models also hacked three organizations on their own
highlights.description: After OpenAI's admission that its models broke into Hugging Face, Anthropic has now admitted that the models it was testing also hacked other organizations.

highlights.title: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
highlights.description: Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and accessed outside systems.

highlights.title: Amazon's Zoox is the first steering wheel-free robotaxi to get regulatory approval for paid rides
highlights.description: The NHTSA has given Amazon's Zoox permission to charge for rides. It's the first AV with no manual controls to get it.

highlights.title: Tesla weighs selling China business to clear path for SpaceX merger
highlights.description: Tesla is looking at cutting loose its China business to clear a path toward a merger with SpaceX, according to a new Wall Street Journal report. If true, it would be a massive deal in the auto industry. Tesla’s Shanghai factory builds more than half of all Tesla vehicles, so any separation would carve out the single biggest piece of Tesla’s car operation.

highlights.title: Apple drops 7%, Amazon surges 12% as investors pick AI winners after earnings
highlights.description: Shares of Amazon jumped sharply in premarket trading on Friday while Apple dropped as investors digest earnings.

highlights.title: SK Hynix, Samsung shares skyrocket to clock best days as AI rally roars back
highlights.description: South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics soared more than 20% on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks.

highlights.title: DeepSeek Unveils Public Beta API for Flagship AI Model
highlights.description: China’s DeepSeek rolled out a public beta application programming interface, or API, for its flagship artificial intelligence model, V4 Flash, touting advancements in agentic abilities.

ai.title: Thinking Machines debuts Inkling Small open source AI model nearing performance of predecessor at about 1/4 size
ai.description: Just two weeks after Thinking Machines released Inkling, its first open source AI language model, the well-funded startup led by former OpenAI chief technology officer Mira Murati today introduced Inkling-Small without sacrificing much of any performance — and in fact, the new model surpasses its larger predecessor on several benchmarks. Inkling Small is a 276-billion-parameter multimodal reasoning model with a permissive Apache 2.0 license that comes within a single point of its larger sibling
